name: hotel-marea-alta
description: Hotel Marea Alta · Paracas — Next.js 16 + NestJS 11 + PostgreSQL

scripts.dev: concurrently -n API,WEB -c cyan,yellow "npm run dev -w @marea/api" "npm run dev -w @marea/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @marea/shared && npm run build -w @marea/api && npm run build -w @marea/web
scripts.start: concurrently -n API,WEB -c cyan,yellow "npm run start -w @marea/api" "npm run start -w @marea/web"
scripts.test: npm run test -w @marea/shared && npm run test -w @marea/api
